tasks.design: Assemble report sections and evidence references natively from {OTHER}, the case register, into {DOCS}. Use a bounded narrative draft only for source-grounded synthesis; the investigator checks the complete report before a separate save.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: case fields can populate report templates and models can propose source-linked narratives for substantive review.

assumptions: Boundary is writing and saving the report, not sending it to a client. This statement does not require a client send; any later release needs its own final-recipient approval and action outside this writing estimate.

Existing investigation work supplies actual event time, method, source, observation, exhibit reference and uncertainty in ordinary logs; capture remains labour in those source tasks and is not claimed saved here. s1 verifies sources and counts resolving absent or conflicting facts. Missing facts remain explicit gaps.

Native case templates and full source-preserving assembly come first. Central retains 60% of section compilation and 50% of narrative preparation plus all s4 final review. No new upstream tagged findings are assumed; s1/s2 include their selection and entry. If current native reporting already suffices, no change is made.

Final report exists before s4 approval; edits void it. Same-system s5 save is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=75, gross=25; incremental focal source/template upkeep=2; net=23. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Source-log completeness and actual narrative correction effort.
research_questions: Compare report preparation including source selection, claim checking and all correction time.

assumptions: Boundary is the paid investigation from client clarification through actual finding logs. Separate report writing is represented by task 13095, not credited again here. Detailed source searches and background checks are alternative decompositions of research within this broad task; a role roll-up must reconcile overlapping time rather than add all task estimates.

s2 counts recording assignment purpose, approved subject identifiers, source list, method justification and permissions. Source owners produce their existing records; s3 includes reading originals, identity verification and manual retrieval of unsupported or unavailable fields. Only query reuse/interface handling shrinks; substantive reading remains.

OTHER means authorised case/research systems and, in s4, the physical interview or observation setting. s4 and s5 supply and capture actual findings; a search result or planned method never becomes an actual observation. Native source configuration comes first; no new third-party data feed is assumed.

Central retains 80% of research and all other work. Final actual logs are confirmed in s5 before s6 save; edits invalidate approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; incremental focal source-access upkeep=1; net=5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Permitted source coverage and actual query-entry burden within research.
research_questions: Observe paid cases and isolate reusable query handling from reading, interviewing and evidence interpretation.

assumptions: Existing assignment supplies permitted purpose and subject; investigator verifies identifiers and selects actual queries in s1/s2. Source owners publish original records with record ID, source, date and original text. No entitlement to credit/tax data is assumed from its existence; unavailable or unpermitted resources are not queried.

Central applies to source interfaces that support native saved queries or exports. s3 counts human query handling and retrieval, not existing database runtime. Its retained 60% includes checks and manual source exceptions; s4 original reading and identity resolution and s5 actual finding extraction remain fully counted.

Native configuration comes first; no autonomous search agent, inferred target, new scraping or free upstream tagging is assumed. Where current interfaces already remove query repetition, no change is made. Detailed searches overlap research in broad task 13099 and must not be added twice.

s6 confirms the completed log before s7; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=86, gross=14; incremental focal source/query upkeep=1; net=13. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: authorised source interfaces can reuse verified identifiers and models can draft source-attributed findings summaries for human review.

assumptions: Boundary runs from authorised scope through a saved findings summary. No hiring decision, character prediction, target selection or client release is automated or priced. Background checks overlap source search and broad investigation tasks; roll-ups must reconcile ownership and time.

Assignment owner supplies authorised purpose and requested checks; verified identity records and source entitlement records exist before s2. Source owners supply original record IDs, dates and text. s3 retains manual unavailable-source handling, and s4 includes actual finding selection and capture. Missing or uncertain identity matches remain unresolved.

Native source queries and checklist templates come first. Central retains 70% of retrieval and summary drafting, plus all source assessment and final review. Model access must be approved for the permitted data; otherwise keep manual summary and do not deploy that element. No new data acquisition or upstream capture is assumed free.

s6 follows the completed summary and binds its final version; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving. Provisional B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5; incremental focal source/guidance upkeep=2; net=8.5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
